purpose: Isolate WHOOP live collection from historical transfer without changing normal collection preferences
changes: Correct WHOOP 5 command-response payload slicing to use its format/declared-length header, on Apple and Android.
Use real checksummed WHOOP 5 envelopes in existing Android advertising-name fixtures; the former WHOOP 4-style fixtures masked the length bug.
Add explicit support-only passive/live/released/history phases, notification-subscription evidence and non-identifying candidate preparation/status fields.
Defer automatic offloads only during the explicit isolated probe; clear on completion with a six-minute fail-safe.
Support an explicit non-destructive history cancellation/retry comparison using the existing curated command.

verification.standaloneParity: Actual Swift and Kotlin payload helpers produce byte-identical output over eight short, malformed and multi-byte length cases.

hardware.backgroundReceiptAndPersistence: Observed with appState=background in the live, released and history captures.
hardware.lockedReceiptAndPersistence: Observed separately on build547 between two locked-state readouts; fresh HR and successful database flushes continued. This is a short observation, not an overnight guarantee.
hardware.hello: Pending followed by Success, current clock candidate and zero preparation bits under the documented 50.42 layout; offsets are not asserted universal.
hardware.range: The candidate write cursor and most recent timestamp advanced between reads; metadata does not validate the contents or recoverability of every stored page.
hardware.manualHistory: Issued after range with no overlapping offload. Success response carried body prefix 0b0000, but no historical sensor or metadata frame arrived.
hardware.abortRetry: Abort acknowledged, candidate read cursor reset without a trim acknowledgement; subsequent offload again returned 0b0000 and no history frames.
hardware.overnightCapturePreferences: Enabled and overnight-only persisted; power-saving master is off.
hardware.interpretation: Live collection and persistence work in these checks. The remaining observed failure is delivery from the strap historical-transfer path, before sensor bytes reach the application.

leadingHypothesis.description: Firmware membership/certificate authorization, based on an independent exact-firmware report where reactivation restored WHOOP and NOOP sync. Not directly proven on this strap; state byte11 has no verified interpretation here.
leadingHypothesis.accountVerification: Official WHOOP sign-in is required to inspect the owner account; no membership change authorized or performed.

limitations: The response-slicing defect was real but fixing it did not restore historical transfer.
No exact interpretation of history state11 or direct proof of a membership lock.
No physiological accuracy claim; synthetic tests and successful Bluetooth replies are distinct from measured collection.
No continuous overnight or force-quit reliability claim.
Firmware alarm and haptic actions were not exercised in this collection investigation.
